name: The Quiet Signal
premise: An abandoned relay repeats a message addressed to your ship. Fuel is scarce; the station may not be empty.

ren.name: Ren
ren.intent: Recover the crew safely before pursuing salvage

goals: Investigate the central mystery without losing your companions

events.title: An arrival
events.description: The relay broadcasts a fragment of an unfamiliar call sign.

events.title: A distant complication
events.description: An unseen faction begins looking for the same answer.

canon.title: The Quiet Signal setting notes
canon.text: A manual service hatch connects the dock to the receiver deck. The docking log stops eighteen days ago.
